title: Do not waste the rare chance of a human life
summary: Great fortune has already opened the door of human life. Treat the chance as too costly to spend without remembrance.
takeaway: Answer the fortune of this body with deliberate remembrance.
lifeApplication: When the day starts feeling ordinary, pause long enough to treat the next action as part of a rare entrusted life.

source.shortMeaning: The human body is obtained by great fortune, and its worth is guarded through Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When the day goes dull, remember how rare this chance already is.

evidence.coreClaim: The human body is obtained by great fortune, and its worth is guarded through Naam.
evidence.turn: The line does not flatter human life; it calls the gift to account.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the day starts feeling ordinary, pause long enough to treat the next action as part of a rare entrusted life.
